data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Βαρβάς (Barbas), derived from βαρβάρος (barbaros), meaning 'foreigner' or 'stranger'. Over time, the name came to be associated with the Greek god Barbaros, who was considered the god of the sea and the guardian of sailors. In Christianity, the name Barbey may be used as a derivation of Bartholomew, which means 'son of Talmai'.
